Hi Ben — thanks for the quick reply. I’m Ethan (lead infra at CodeForge). A few clarifications:

- We’re planning a hybrid approach: initially hosted API for speed, but with a view to Dedicated capacity later.
- Our rough target: p95 < 250ms for single-turn code completion; currently ~5 qps per user, expected to spike during CI runs to ~50 qps.
- Data retention: short-term KV cache only, sensitive customer PII must not be persisted.

Timezones: I’m ET (New York). The Wed 11:00 PT slot is 2pm ET and works for me. Can you confirm which engineer will join and whether you can demo multi-model routing and prefix caching? Also, can you send a calendar invite (Google Calendar) with a Zoom link?
